title: Reconstruction of Many-Body Dynamics from One-Particle Density
exact_target: With the interaction and initial state known, does a particle density determine the driving potential and the resulting many-body evolution?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003219 (OWR-14751-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

status_qualification: The scalar density is not the entire one-particle density matrix. The appropriate potential class, time regularity and gauge equivalence must be kept in a precise reconstruction theorem; these are not supplied in the extraction.
